bioParagraphs: I am Qingle Liu, a third-year undergraduate in [Computer Science at Tsinghua University](https://www.cs.tsinghua.edu.cn/), pursuing a double major in Computer Science and Economics & Finance. My GPA is **3.97/4.0**, ranked **1/33**. My research interests are Computer Vision, Generative Models, and Agents.

I conduct research in [Prof. Shi-Min Hu’s group](https://cg.cs.tsinghua.edu.cn/) at Tsinghua and intern at [MMLab, NTU](https://mmlab-ntu.github.io/) with [Prof. Xingang Pan](https://xingangpan.github.io/). I work on efficient video diffusion models with long-term memory, world models that unify understanding and generation, and agentic robotics.
